list.countOfTotal: {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} of {total}
list.confirmBulkDelete: Delete {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}? This cannot be undone.

empty.title: Blank canvas
empty.body: No posts here yet. Switch to Generate and get inspired.

card.storyBadge: 📱 Story · {count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}}
card.qaWarningTitle: Visual QA did not pass cleanly even after fixes — check the text and diacritics in the image before publishing

facts.title: Claims without factual backing
facts.body: The engine did not find this among the brand’s verified facts. If it is true, confirm it — it gets saved as a fact and can be used directly next time. If it is not, rewrite the text yourself.
facts.rewrite: It is not true — rewrite the text

sources.title: Verified on the web
sources.body: The engine looked this up itself. Sources are not written into the post — if you want to cite them, paste them into the first comment.

variants.cta: Two versions to choose from · {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}
variants.explain: We will generate {count, plural, one {# new version} other {# new versions}} of this post on the same topic — a different hook, visual and CTA. Each is a full post, so together they cost {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}. You pick one, the rest is discarded.
variants.confirm: Generate for {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}

region.hint: Drag over the spot you want to change

edit.reelLocked: A reel’s video cannot be edited — use Generate again
edit.regionHint: · drag over the preview to mark the spot
edit.placeholderImage: What to change — e.g.: move the headline up and make it smaller
edit.placeholderText: What to change — e.g.: shorten the caption, add the price
edit.preservePlaceholder: Keep untouched… (optional) — e.g.: the photo and colours

regenerate.warning: Creates a new post with a completely new visual — a different photo, a different composition
regenerate.created: New draft created — you will find it in the list
regenerate.placeholder: What should be different about the brand-new post...

compare.title: Two versions to choose from
compare.done: Version chosen — the system learns from your preference
compare.pick: Pick the better version — the rest is discarded
compare.saved: Preference saved — the AI learns from your choice

handoff.shareUnsupported: This browser cannot share directly — use Save image + Copy caption.
handoff.shareFailed: Sharing failed. Use Save image + Copy caption below.
handoff.publishingBackground: Publishing in the background — it will show up as Published shortly.
handoff.shared: Shared — the caption is on your clipboard
handoff.desktopHint: 📱 To share straight to Instagram, open this page on your phone. Here on a computer, use Copy caption + Save image.

guide.title: How to
guide.step2: In Instagram, long-press the caption field → Paste.

subtitles.createFailed: The job could not be created.
subtitles.timeout: Re-rendering is taking unusually long. Close the detail and open it again in a moment.
subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.burnedIn: · burned into the video, changed by re-rendering
subtitles.legacy: This reel was made before we started keeping the raw video — its subtitles can only be changed by generating again. New reels can be edited right here.
subtitles.locked: A published reel can no longer be changed on Instagram — subtitles can only be edited on a variant.

pop.label: Highlight
pop.description: Bigger type with the word being spoken in the brand colour. Today’s reel standard — the default.

classic.label: Classic
classic.description: White text with an outline and a subtle backdrop. Readable on anything, does not overpower the image.

cards.label: Cards
cards.description: Large type in a solid box, a few words at a time. Holds attention even without sound.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Just a thin outline, no backdrop. Least intrusive, but gets lost on a bright scene.

subtitles.noCards: This reel has no saved cards.
subtitles.dirtyHint: Change the text or the style
subtitles.timingText: Timings follow the reading pace of the cards and cannot be changed — a shorter card would not be readable in time.
subtitles.timingVoice: Timings follow the spoken narration and cannot be changed — otherwise the subtitle would drift from the voice.
subtitles.replaceNote: The new video replaces the old one; “Undo” brings back the previous version.
